name: After § 28
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Serbia
part_text: 27b. Condemns in the strongest possible term the detention of six activists from the Movement of Free Citizens and the Students against Authoritarian Rule (STAV) organisation in Novi Sad owing to their participation in the mass protest of 15 March 2025; urges the Serbian authorities to immediately release all detained activists and halt legal cases related to the protest of 15 March;
